key_information_units.information: Annual headline financial performance for 2025: like-for-like rental income growth of 4.9% (vs 5.6% in 2024), real economic occupancy flat at 98.5%, net operating income margin improved to 72.1% (70.3% in 2024), property values up 2.9% year-on-year, privatization sales of SEK 10,664 million (2,466 units at 28.9% premium), SEK 44,900 million asset-backed financing and SEK 14,600 million capital markets issuance (six green transactions), with credit metrics at Net LTV 52.2% (56.4%) and ICR 2.0x (1.9x).
key_information_units.source_evidence: MD&A: 2025 in Brief, Key Figures table, Funding section

key_information_units.information: Q4 2025 performance: like-for-like rental growth of 4.6% (5.3% in Q4 2024), rental income decreased 3.4% to SEK 3,945 million, real economic occupancy rose to 98.7% (98.6% in Q4 2024), net operating income margin held at 70.2% (LTM margin 72.1%), privatization sales of SEK 2,890 million (798 units at 32.5% premium vs 24% in Q4 2024), property values up 0.5%, goodwill impairment loss of SEK 3,707 million, and credit metrics at Net LTV 52.2% (56.4%) and ICR 2.0x (1.9x).
key_information_units.source_evidence: MD&A: Q4 Highlights, Key Figures table for Q4

key_information_units.information: Operational performance drivers: standing assets contributed SEK 800 million rental income growth via indexation, tenant improvements, and occupancy gains; like-for-like growth decomposed into indexations (3.3% of 4.9% annual growth), tenant improvements (0.7%), occupancy improvements (0.7%), and rent reversion (0.2%); property expenses decreased 6.1% annually to SEK 4,378 million due to digitalisation and portfolio contraction; capital expenditures of SEK 3,893 million allocated to maintenance (SEK 1,790m), sustainability (SEK 557m), tenant improvements (SEK 1,168m), and value-add (SEK 241m).
key_information_units.source_evidence: MD&A: Rental Income Development, Like-for-like Development, Property Expenses, Asset Management sections

key_information_units.information: Country-specific investment property fair value developments: Sweden +0.8% (SEK 717m) from rental performance; Germany +1.2% (SEK 926m) despite privatisation strategy shift; Denmark +7.2% (SEK 4,643m) from ownership market strength; Czechia +6.7% (SEK 1,856m) from rental growth; Netherlands +5.4% (SEK 1,424m) with privatisation as highest-and-best use; Norway -2.7% (SEK -382m) from buy-to-let supply increase; UK -0.4% (SEK -20m) from yield stabilisation; Poland +4.1% (SEK 173m) and Finland +4.3% (SEK 161m) from rental growth and rent reversion.
key_information_units.source_evidence: MD&A: Investment Properties, Country Fair Value Development section

key_information_units.information: Liquidity and financing: Heimstaden Bostad completed SEK 59,500 million financing (refinancings and new financings); liability management in January 2025 issued SEK 750 million senior unsecured floating rate notes and EUR 430 million/400 million fixed rate notes while tendering existing maturities; interest expenses of SEK 6,536 million (average rate 3.43% vs 3.01% in 2024); interest coverage ratio improved to 2.0x (1.9x); net loan-to-value decreased to 52.2% (56.4%); unutilised credit facilities of SEK 23,449 million at parent level.
key_information_units.source_evidence: MD&A: Funding section, Interest Expenses, Liability Management, Alternative Performance Measures

key_information_units.information: Material post-reporting-period events: December 2025 arbitration award in favour of Heimstaden confirmed no breach of Heimstaden Bostad Shareholders' Agreement; January 2025 issuance of EUR 500 million perpetual hybrid maturity by Heimstaden Bostad replaced EUR 500 million perpetual hybrid resetting in April 2026.
key_information_units.source_evidence: MD&A: Q4 Highlights (arbitration), Funding section (hybrid bond)

key_information_units.information: Sustainability performance: weather-corrected energy intensity reduced 10% to 148 kWh/m² (exceeding 2% target); GHG emissions reduced 14.2% against 2020 baseline (on track for 42% reduction by 2030); EU Taxonomy-aligned revenue at 22% (26% in 2024) and capex at 18% (22% in 2024); green assets valued at approximately SEK 76 billion supported green bond issuance of SEK 13,767 million in FY25; sustainability-linked loans of SEK 5,818 million all met KPIs (Sustainalytics Negligible Risk, SBTi emission target achievement).
key_information_units.source_evidence: Sustainability Report: Highlights, E1 sections, EU Taxonomy tables
